# windows_disk (Data Source)

Reads the observed state of a disk on a remote Windows host via SSH and PowerShell (`Get-Disk`) without managing it.

Lookup is by exactly one of `unique_id` (the stable identity, preferred), `serial_number`, `location` or `number`. Zero matches are an error, several matches are an `ambiguous_disk` error. Disks hosting the OS, the active pagefile, the crash-dump target, or clustered disks are refused fail-closed with `protected_storage`, as is a disk whose placement cannot be determined. Selecting by `number` emits a warning: Windows assigns numbers at scan time and they can shift across reboots.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Look up a disk by its stable UniqueId without managing it.
data "windows_disk" "data" {
  unique_id = "SCSI\\DISK&VEN_MSFT&PROD_VIRTUAL_DISK&REV_1.0"
}

output "disk_size_bytes" {
  value = data.windows_disk.data.size_bytes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `location` (String) Get-Disk Location (adapter path) of the disk to look up, matched case-insensitively after trimming whitespace. Exactly one of unique_id, serial_number, location and number must be specified.
- `number` (Number) Get-Disk Number of the disk to look up. Exactly one of unique_id, serial_number, location and number must be specified. Disk numbers are assigned by Windows at scan time and can shift across reboots: using number emits a warning, prefer unique_id.
- `serial_number` (String) Get-Disk SerialNumber of the disk to look up, matched case-insensitively after trimming whitespace. Exactly one of unique_id, serial_number, location and number must be specified.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `unique_id` (String) Stable Get-Disk UniqueId of the disk to look up. Exactly one of unique_id, serial_number, location and number must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `bus_type` (String) Get-Disk BusType (e.g. SATA, NVMe, RAID, USB, Virtual), as observed on the host.
- `friendly_name` (String) Get-Disk FriendlyName, as observed on the host.
- `health_status` (String) Get-Disk HealthStatus (e.g. Healthy), as observed on the host.
- `id` (String) Data source identifier; the stable Get-Disk UniqueId of the observed disk.
- `is_boot` (Boolean) Whether the disk is the boot disk, as observed on the host.
- `is_clustered` (Boolean) Whether the disk is clustered, as observed on the host.
- `is_offline` (Boolean) Whether the disk is offline, as observed on the host.
- `is_read_only` (Boolean) Whether the disk is read-only, as observed on the host.
- `is_system` (Boolean) Whether the disk is the system disk, as observed on the host.
- `operational_status` (String) Get-Disk OperationalStatus (e.g. Online, Offline), as observed on the host.
- `partition_style` (String) Partition style of the disk (RAW, MBR or GPT), as observed on the host.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Get-Disk Size in bytes, as observed on the host.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
